paragraphs.source_en: Unable to bear the pain, Yoshifuyu spoke in broken gasps. “We have been tricked... Asai, Okada, I am going on ahead...” Before he could finish, he collapsed with a thud into a pool of blood.

units.source_en: “This is our lord’s will, traitor.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Our lord is the true traitor. If he suspected us, his retainers, why did he not question us first and then order us to commit seppuku? He walked straight into the trap laid by Chikuzen and even stooped to luring loyal retainers to their deaths...”
